thesis.core: Baiya has a credible Freedom Point feminine-hygiene franchise, product mix upgrading and fast non-core-province expansion, but 2026Q3 attributable loss RMB41.82m and 9M attributable profit decline 43.92% contradict a current durable earnings inflection. Core-region channel inventory reset and aggressive acquisition spending mean that revenue resilience has not translated into incremental owner earnings.
thesis.variant_wedge: 2026 nine-month gross profit improved modestly, but selling expenses increased RMB155.1m against only RMB66.7m revenue growth; 2026Q3 revenue fell 4.64% and profit turned negative. The 2026-10-27 share price capitalizes a high-confidence rebound before its profitability is demonstrated.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Do not annualize Q1 2026's unusually strong RMB143.7m or 9M 2026 RMB137.2m. Use scenario 2027 sustainable attributable net profits RMB150m/260m/360m, anchored to audited FY2025 ~RMB208m and FY2024 ~RMB288m, explicitly conditional on channel recovery and normalized selling-expense efficiency.

operating_and_financial_quality.core_noncore_channel: 9M offline RMB1.646bn (+1.3%), online RMB0.992bn (+6.3%), non-core-province offline +29.3%; Q3 core-region inventory reset depressed offline sales, and online was approximately flat.
operating_and_financial_quality.capital_return: FY2025 cash dividend RMB0.40/share paid May 2026; 2026 buyback 1.7424m shares by September at RMB23.99m cost earmarked for employee incentive, not assumed retired.
operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Brand, margin and cash conversion retain real value; 9M CFO less capex positive RMB114.1m and low interest-bearing debt mitigate solvency risk. But growth acquisition costs and inventory adjustment are not yet proved transitory. Receivables increased, 9M selling expenses grew far faster than sales, and Q3 profit turned negative; normalized recovery and premium P/E must be earned.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Scenarios are analyst recovery assumptions rather than issuer guidance. Base requires regained core-region sales and materially better selling-expense productivity; bull exceeds prior peak and needs evidence. Valuation excludes uncertain growth beyond the explicit 12-18 month horizon.

catalysts: Two consecutive quarters of core five-province sell-through and shipments normalizing without channel stuffing.
Non-core provinces maintain profitable double-digit expansion while incremental marketing spend produces positive incremental operating profit.
Gross-margin gains survive promotion competition and quarterly attributable earnings return sustainably positive.
Operating cash flow less maintenance capex remains positive without receivables or platform settlement deterioration.
kill_thesis: Core-province inventory/channel transition lasts beyond the planned normalization period or local brand share declines.
Selling expense ratio remains above 40% without corresponding revenue and normalized EBIT growth.
Further negative attributable quarters, persistent net working-capital consumption or increased receivable impairments.
Marketing spend and product innovation fail to deliver a defendable premium as channel price competition intensifies.
